1.consolidated_definition: Colocar al núcleo de acero de un elemento estructural una armazón, generalmente de madera, para verter el hormigón y darle una forma determinada.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To place a steel core of a structural element with a framework, typically made of wood, to pour concrete and give it a predetermined shape.
